01 — Who We Are

BUILT
BY
PEOPLE
WHO LIVED
IT
Now in Los Angeles

Nocturna is led by a Ukrainian creative team based in Los Angeles — organizers, producers, and artists with 14+ years of hands-on experience in the underground electronic scene.

The team built and ran events across Ukraine, Poland (Kraków), and Israel — large-scale multi-day festivals, international collaborations, and club nights with artists from Berlin, Amsterdam, and Milan.

Now rooted in LA, they are building a platform that documents and elevates the contemporary electronic scene on the West Coast — precisely, consciously, and with style.

02 — Community

Nocturna is more than a production collective — it’s a community built around people who genuinely live the nightlife culture.

The project has received strong support from both artists we’ve collaborated with and the people attending our events. From the very beginning, our intention was never to create something for everyone. We deliberately focused on building a space for those who truly connect with our vision, sound, and atmosphere.

That intentional focus naturally shaped a close and engaged community — people who don’t just attend events, but actively contribute to the culture around them.

Today, our community gets early access to mixes and event recordings, participates in selecting future artists, and helps shape the direction of the project itself. This creates a deeper sense of involvement and shared ownership between the audience, artists, and the platform.

At its core, Nocturna was founded to support the growth of underground culture in Los Angeles through our own artistic perspective — shaped by years of organizing events, festivals, and creative projects.

We believe strong communities create lasting cultural movements. That’s why we’re always open to meaningful collaborations with artists, collectives, and creative partners who share the same mindset.

03 — The Pavilion Series

Each Pavilion is a live research episode — filmed at a unique Los Angeles location with professional lighting, sound, and cameras. Artists receive full cinematic content: DJ set recording, interview, and a conceptual video. Every Pavilion streams live and is released as a standalone show.

05 — Track Record

Kraków → Tel Aviv → Los Angeles

Before building Nocturna in LA, the same team spent years producing independent events and festivals across Poland, Ukraine, and Israel — under three distinct projects that together form the foundation of everything Nocturna stands for today.

Kraków, PL · 2022–2026
CRASH TEST
A rave and interdisciplinary nightlife series founded in Kraków in 2022. 22 events · 4,500+ attendees · 60+ artists. Known for combining intense dancefloor programming with exhibitions, light installations, scenographic décor, and immersive spatial design. Each event treated as a complete audiovisual environment.
Daniela Hensel · YouSawLaurent · Operitual · Low Order · San Proper · Noury Lizarraga +
Israel · 2021–2024
KVISA
Multi-day festival format operating across Tel Aviv, Haifa, and outdoor locations. Multi-day · Multi-stage · 100+ artists. Combined electronic music, live performances, digital art exhibitions, tattoos, and international bookings from Berlin, Amsterdam, and Milan.
Low Order · Anna Berg · Donderbus · Noury Lizarraga · Shurra · Kedasta +
Kraków, PL · 2022–2024
UKRAiNATV
A Kraków-based Ukrainian stream-art collective and hybrid media force. Transmediale (DE) · Locarno Film Festival (CH) · Sónar+ (ES) · Unsound (PL) · Framer Framed (NL) · ACMI Melbourne (AU). Treating streaming as an artistic medium — bodies, sounds, and political realities across borders in real time.
International festival presence · Live transmissions · Hybrid performances
